# `adi-llm-gateway` — types

> The adi LLM gateway: one loopback endpoint every model client is pointed at, which forwards each request verbatim to the provider and journals it to the shared store.

### enum `Message`

What the writing thread accepts: rows, and a request to say when it has caught up.

```rust

enum Message {
    Row(Box<Entry>),
    Flush(Sender<()>),
}
```

### struct `Journal`

A handle onto the writing thread. Cloning it is how each connection gets one.

